name: Aluminum; combined hot and cold rolling; at plant
description: This gate-to-gate represents the production of cold rolled aluminum coil from cast aluminum ingots in a combined hot an cold rolling line, with optional annealing. No co-products are produced. Data reflects North American production.
category: 31-33: Manufacturing/3313: Alumina and Aluminum Production and Processing

processDocumentation.timeDescription: Emissions data reflects 2015. Energy data reflects 2016
processDocumentation.technologyDescription: This dataset represents a combined hot and cold rolling process. Ingots are heated to 1000 degrees F and are fed into a reversing mill followed by a continuous hot mill. Hot rolled coil is optionally annealed or self-annealed and fed into a continuous cold rolling mill to attain the final desired thickness.
processDocumentation.modelingConstantsDescription: Water vapor is excluded from the inventory
processDocumentation.completenessDescription: CUTOFF flows act as placeholders for several waste flows without available techosphere data. A mass balance was performed on the foreground unit process by the original data developers and no flows were knowlingly omitted.
processDocumentation.dataSelectionDescription: Primary data was collected from U.S., Canadian and international producers that supply the North American market. Data providers reflect >95% of production in the target region.
processDocumentation.dataTreatmentDescription: Inventory data was pulled directly from the cited source file. Conversion factors were applied during technosphere flow mapping in cases where the source and target flow are reported in different units.
